data.lighting: 透亮的早晨阳光穿过椰林叶隙，在沙滩与金色长发上泼洒出明亮的金色光斑

data.description: 木屋前的椰林里传出螺栓拧动的轻快金属音。玛莉娅盘腿坐在凉席上，金发随手扎了个利落的高马尾，鼻尖上还蹭了点水上发动机的润滑油。她擦了一把额角的薄汗，举起扳手得意地向你展示改装完毕的冲浪板——「博士来得正好！喷射引擎的进气口改小了半圈，推进效率提高了整整两成！走，今天换我带你在浪头上飞一把！」
data.promptProse: Blemishine sits cross-legged on a canvas mat in the sandy courtyard outside a seaside workshop, her hair tied into a high ponytail and a sheen of sweat on her brow. Dressed in a golden-yellow and ivory halter bikini with double hip cords under a sheer unbuttoned linen shirt, she holds up a wrench beside her tuned motorized surfboard under dappled morning palm shade.
data.animaCaption: Seated cross-legged on a canvas beach mat beside a motorized surfboard, she raises a wrench with a proud, sun-flushed smile in her golden halter bikini and open linen shirt. Morning sunlight filters through palm fronds in bright dappled patches across the sand.
